description:
Soundtracked by 'The Real Thing' Jürgen Klopp delivers his final goodbye to Liverpool FC supporters ahead of taking charge of the Reds at Anfield for the final time, with a Premier League game against Wolverhampton Wanderers to bring down the curtain on nine years at LFC.

This video is available with subtitles in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Arabic, Indonesian, Thai, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese.
